WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY BillingState
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT invoice_count,
           invoice_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share,
           AVG(invoice_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_count
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoice_count - avg_count) AS average_invoices_above_average
FROM state_stats
WHERE invoice_count > avg_count;
